API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPartner IntegrationsGet Account Group By Id
Get Account Group By Id
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/accountGroups/:id

Retrieves the specific AWS account group details based on the provided group ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
int32
REQUIRED

The ID of the AWS account group.

QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Specifies the page offset.

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size.

Default value: 250
Responses
​
default

Default response. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

The ID of the AWS account group.

name
string

The name of the AWS account group. Must be non-null, non-empty, unique, and 128 characters or fewer in length.

description
string

(Optional) The description of the AWS account group. Must be less than or equal to 512 characters.

cloudConnectorGroups
object[]
cloudType
string

The cloud type. The default and manadatory value is AWS.

Possible values: [AWS, AZURE, GCP]

publicCloudAccounts
object[]
